gen-gf-revalia-gf-khula: Khula reads tall in the middle, with curves that stay open. Against that sans, Revalia stretches out with an open-bottomed g and relaxed, widely spaced letters, which is the pair's real hook.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-lexend-deca: Loud meets level: Revalia sprawls with a tall band of letters and short stalks above. And Lexend Deca keeps an unshaded line that never swells, small-looking capitals sitting beside big lowercase.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-liter: Loose swagger on top, a ruler-straight line below. Revalia is best at showing off, with its open-curved g and widely spaced letters, while Liter is best at tall, wide-mouthed lowercase without stroke contrast.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-mada: Swagger up top: Revalia leaves its g open at the bottom and strides along loosely. But Mada does the quiet work, with a towering midzone and curves that refuse to close.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-matangi: Matangi lays down rounded, open letters in strokes of constant width, like cut ribbon, with a hefty lowercase body. Revalia sprawls above it, loud and loose, giving them clear roles.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Revalia strides loosely, its g left open at the bottom. Next to it, Mochiy Pop One feels like precise blueprint lettering, with an oversized lowercase and a constant, unvarying line.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-nokora: Widely separated letters give Revalia a relaxed, showy stride. Nokora is best at weight, laying a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line with an s that never tightens.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Big, loose and expressive: Revalia leaves its g open at the bottom. And Noto Sans Adlam reads easily over many lines, its curve endings kept apart and c, s and z standing tall.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unjoin: Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined keeps generous space between curve ends and stems, with little height gap between cases. While Revalia swaggers above, widely spaced and loud, the two split the work.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-hi: Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs reads crisp and modern, its x-height rising close to cap height. But Revalia brings the swagger, so its open-bottomed g and loose spacing stand out against that sturdy text.
